blocks.text: 2 Chronicles 8 contains 18 verses. It opens with: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, wherein Solomon had built the house of Jehovah, and his own house, It concludes with: And Huram sent him by the hands of his servants ships, and servants that had knowledge of the sea; and they came with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and fetched from thence four hundred and fifty talents of gold, and brought them to king Solomon.
